narrative.overview: kywk.me 的首頁視覺體系「現代主義探險公報（Modernist Cartography Gazette）」將個人數位花園從傳統模板昇華為兼具「探險家等高線航圖」與「工匠發佈終端」的工作室門戶。
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed Hero stage connected by topographic contour lines and a digital light mesh
Zero-redundancy four-stage architecture (Hero, Three Pillars, Side Projects Matrix, Editorial Streams)
Dual-theme native comfort (Warm Ivory Parchment #fffdfb & Deep Basalt #1a1512)
Single-dimension elevation with flat-at-rest hairline borders and hover-only lift

rules.name: The Single-Dimension Elevation Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest commit to a 1px hairline border without diffuse shadows; soft elevation shadows appear only on hover or focus.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own weight. Never place a small uppercase kicker or eyebrow label directly above a heading.

dos: 保持雙主題色彩的舒適對比度（常規文字 ≥ 4.5:1，標題 ≥ 3:1）。
讓標題自帶份量，開門見山傳遞資訊。
所有連結與導向使用全站已驗證之正規化路徑。
確保微互動具備平滑回饋。
donts: 禁止使用任何 Eyebrow / Kicker 標籤架在主標題上方。
禁止使用文字漸層色（Gradient text）。
禁止使用三欄均分、內容貧乏的模板卡片。
禁止在沒有實際地圖或繪圖需求時引入高開銷第三方重量級依賴。
